name: calendar-flex/caldav
description: calendar-flex CalDAV service: SabreDAV 4.7+ embedded in a small PHP 8.4 service with the Postgres PDO backend (D-02). The service itself arrives with E03-R01.

scripts.test: @php -r "if (!is_dir('tests')) { echo 'caldav: no registered unit tests yet; pass', PHP_EOL; } else { passthru('vendor/bin/phpunit --no-configuration --do-not-cache-result tests', \$code); exit(\$code); }"
